profile.headline: Project Manager / Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Specialties: C++, C#, Visual Basic, .Net, C
Visual Studio 2002/2005/2008, VSTS 2010, Rational ClearQuest 6.0/7.0, Adobe Acrobat 8.0/9.0, VMWare Workstation 6.5, EPI Emulator Software, XRAY Sim/Emulator
Rational ClearCase 6.0/7.0, 
OOD, OOP, DO-178A/B, Boeing D6, RUP, JUP, CMM SEI, 2167A, ARINC 665-2/429, Mil-Std 1553
Windows Vista, XP, 2000, 98, 95, NT4.0, pSOS
MS Office Professional 2003/2007, MS Project 2003/2007, MS Visio 2003

positions.title: Project Manager / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Manage SW projects and Simulator update projects.

Design, Code and Integrate Flight simulation display software for incorporation into larger Flight Simulator for Boeing Aircraft.

positions.title: Sustainment C&T Database Lead
positions.description: Coordinate the modification and incorporation of the Command and Telemetry Database utilized for the S-NPP Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS) program. Define and implement process for modification and release of the C&T Database.

positions.title: C3S Sustainment Software Lead
positions.description:
Sustainment Lead over the C3S Software area for Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS) Common Ground System (CGS).
Selected as recipient of Technical Honors distintion for IIS Division

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintenence of the Telemetry & Command and Eval components for Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS) Common Ground System (CGS). Software products include C++, C, Java, Shell Script, Fortran 99 using Microsft and Cygwin environments.

positions.title: Application Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Jeppesen technical representative in EFB discussions for current and future projects with Boeing
Introduced and Implemented Continuous Integration, Test Driven Development and a Hybrid Pair Programming concept to follow a Agile-style process
Introduced Functional Point Analysis for task decomposition
Working with Project Management to identify and measure Earned Value more accurately
Defined new Coding Standards for use with C# language
Defined new Software Engineering Plan for Cross-Platform development
Rewriting 70% of application in C# utilizing some existing key components in C++ for multi-class project creating bridge components between C# and existing native/non-managed code
Consistently and successfully deliver product to Customer on time and within budget
Worked to change internal processes (Waterfall to Iterative) to provide a more efficient work flow from Systems Engineers, Architecture, Development and Test groups
Assist Project Management with task identification during project definition phase 
Design adhered strictly to Human Factors guidelines for Pilot Workload defined by Boeing
Refactored legacy C++ classes to be more efficient and reduce application start-up time by 20% for Class 1 project
Successfully maintained and improved legacy C/C++ code base for Class 3 project
Analysis of Defect and Enhancement Change requests 
Participate/Present at PDR/CDR/CCBs with internal disciplines and with customer
Integration of application using VMWare and target hardware locally and at customer site
Designed and coded EFB application to DO-178B Level D also following Boeing D6 Standards
Converted older projects into Visual Studio 2005 to provide an increase of application stability
Utilized Model-View-Controller architectural pattern for MFC-based code implementation
Introduced tailored RUP process to legacy waterfall program
Reviewed and approved Software Requirements, Code and Tests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Ground Viewer framework for Terminal Charts application using C# and VB on schedule
Integrated Aircraft Interface simulator for Terminal Charts application debug environment
One of Three developers assigned to design and develop Ground Viewer on short schedule
Created Windows-based command line tool to create aviation LSAPs
Utilized Boeing proprietary interface for part packaging
Succesfully maintain and improve legacy C/C++ code base
Utilization of Model-View-Controller architectural pattern for MFC based code implementation

positions.title: Ramp Service Agent
positions.description:
Promoted within first year to Lead/Coordinator position of Baggage Transfer area
Lowered missed flight baggage transfers by 30%
Worked with management and HR to improve work environment
99% on-time turn around rate for all flights handled
Worked with management to reduce operating costs in Baggage Transfer area by 10%
Lead, direct and train Ramp Service Agents in their normal duties and approve finished work
Ground service of aircraft including load/unload, air starts, pack/secure cargo and equipment
Marshal/tow, block, pushback, de-ice and wave off aircraft
Receive, route and dispatch of cargo and passenger baggage according to company procedures

positions.title: Stock Associate
positions.description:
Completely re-organized back stock room for efficiency and maintainability
Customer Service to support sales to client of correct merchandise
Maintain proper and clean store
Stock merchandise for visual display completeness and accuracy
Ship and Receive stock for store

positions.title: National Sales Manager
positions.description:
Increased nationwide B2B sales from 50 to 300+ accounts adding over 20 multi-year contracts
Doubled annual revenues first year, Achieving 125% sales goal second year
Developed and implemented company's marketing for its business products
Successfully entered four new markets for both sales and rental products including marketing to the country music industry (attracted over 15 country music touring groups)
Implemented new rental software tracking system for rental business
Created company processes to maintain no lost inventory 2 years in a row
Sales & Rentals of Two-Way radio systems and equipment to C-Level executives
Increased and maintain clients through phone, networking, hospitality events, trade shows and CRM
Managed office staff of five, along with sales staff and shipping & receiving department
Maintained internal computer network and desktop systems

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Increased B2B sales by 25%, meeting and exceeding sales goals each year
Helped client companies transition from paper-based work place to integrated office environment
Developed and implemented company's marketing for its business products
Web Design & Computer Sales to C-Level executives
Supplied consulting, web design and computer sales for small to medium sized companies
Provide web-based user interface for purchases and data gathering
Created customized applications for display of client information on the Web

positions.title: Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
Participated in analysis and modification of requirements development and documentation for interactive television converter box project
Worked directly with client to determine stakeholder needs for interactive television converter box project
Developed initial screen prototypes using C++ in multi-OS environment (Windows/Unix) ported to 68020 target processor for interactive television converter box
Recommended and implemented PVCS to manage code and document revisions for interactive television converter box
Design utilizing Rational Rose for Object Oriented Design of embedded system software

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Successfully reached Initial Design and 1st Prototype Phase within projected timeline for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System project
Software development using FAA DO-178B Level B Standards for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Structured analysis and design, applying Yourdan/DeMarco’s real-time system methodology for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Utilized OOD for the Command System Module for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Implemented system and maintenance code units in C++ for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Ported developed code from Windows environment to a Motorola 68360 target processor running pSOS OS for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Utilized Rational Rose to design software system for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Used PVCS to manage code and document revisions for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System
Participated in Requirements, Code and Unit Test reviews of all software created for GPS-based Avionics Navigational System

positions.title: Software Test Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
Successfully helped meet first flight deadline for FAA Acceptance of Boeing 777
DO-178A Level A Flight Certification testing of Boeing 777 AIMS system
Embedded system software test for an AMD 29050 based system using ADA and C languages
Automated and Manual testing using In Circuit Emulator to facilitate Structural coverage of code
Created tests and documents for requirements and structural based coverage for DO-178A approval and Boeing D6 Standards
Worked directly with customer to determine needs and incorporate them into requirements and design
Created complete Requirement to Code to Test traceability matrix
Participated in reviews of Software Requirements and Software Design Documents

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Security Clearance obtained
Accelerated responsibility to oversee 4 Display areas, including Radar
Tasked to support software on Flying Test Bed prior to Customer Delivery
Worked directly with the Air Force to determine needs to incorporate into requirements and design
Structured analysis/design using Waterfall/Top-Down real-time system methodology and Hatley/Pirbhai's real-time system specification methodology
Created new and modified legacy software using Jovial for an embedded 1750 based processor system
Created and modified design, code, functional and unit test modules for the Cockpit Display System (GUI)
Participation in Technical Interchange and Change Control Meetings with Management and Air Force personnel
Utilized Software Through Pictures CASE tool in OpenWindows environment based on Sun SparcStations
Verified module and system code on test stands in standalone and integrated environments
Completed Life Cycle Development using Mil-Std-1553 Standards
Participated in CMM SEI 3 achievement with the organization
Participated in reviews of Software Requirements Document, Software Design Document 
Utilized CMS to manage code and document revisions
